name: domain_non_ascii_name
description: A CREATE DOMAIN name whose uppercase form has a different byte length than its original (e.g. U+FB01 the ligature fi becomes the two-byte-longer FI) must not panic -- a byte offset computed on the uppercased copy was previously sliced directly against the original string
schema_sql: CREATE DOMAIN ﬁﬁ AS text NOT NULL
CREATE TABLE t (id integer NOT NULL)
